probe.text_sample: Your Page Title kinfolk ® Shop Journal Help About Contact Overview Buy Kinfolk 0 0 0 0 Categories Show all 13 Face 5 Body 4 Refills 3 Gift cards 1 Restorative face oil €64 Hydrating serum €58 Body oil €48 Gift card From €25 Shop Journal Help About Contact Overview Buy Kinfolk Account About Kinfolk makes skincare in small batches in a former bakery outside Turin. Short ingredient lists, no fragrance, and glass bottles you keep for years and refill when they run low. How we work Only what works If an ingredient does not do a job you can feel or see, it does not go in. Most of our formulas have fewer than fifteen ingredients, and every one is listed with what it does. Small batches We fill a few hundred bottles at a time, so nothing sits in a warehouse for months. Most products reach you within six weeks of being made. Tested on people Every product is used daily for eight weeks by a panel of forty people with different skin types, sensitive skin included, before it goes on sale. Never on animals.
